name: Station RTU command-authority gate
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Accepts the documented remote commands only when the station authority conditions permit them.
description: Accepts the documented remote commands only when the station authority conditions permit them. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Remote command and authority” at the input and “Authorized station command” at the output. Authority does not remove equipment operating interlocks.
